restaurant_name: Doctor Koh Phangan Takecare Medical Clinic
text:
I would like to share my experience to help others who might find themselves in a similar situation.

I visited this clinic in Thailand because of unusual discharge. After a urine rapid test, I was informed about one hour later that I tested positive for both chlamydia and gonorrhea. This result came as a shock to me and did not feel consistent with my situation.

After returning to Germany, I had comprehensive laboratory testing done again, and all results came back negative. This indicates that the initial test result was most likely a false positive.

I do not believe that the clinic acted with bad intentions. My understanding is that rapid tests are commonly used in Thailand for quick screening. However, these tests are known to have a higher risk of false-positive results compared to standard laboratory diagnostics.

I am sharing this review simply to inform other patients: if you receive test results within a very short time (such as one hour), they may not be 100% accurate and should ideally be confirmed with further testing.
